sec: 4.1 Basic Components of a Web Page

cards.t: Three components of a web page: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
cards.en:
A website is a collection of web pages. Each page is built from three technologies with different jobs:
  • HTML uses markups (tags) to describe the structure and content of a web page (headings, paragraphs, tables, images, links).
  • CSS (Cascading Style Sheet) describes the appearance/style of HTML elements (colour, font, layout).
  • JavaScript is a programming language embedded in HTML that adds dynamic, interactive programs (e.g. respond to a click, read data from a table).
Exam tip: if a question asks which part controls structure, answer HTML; look, CSS; behaviour/interaction, JavaScript.
cards.zh:
网站由一系列网页组成，每个网页由三种技术合作完成：
  • HTML：用标记（tags）描述网页的结构与内容，例如标题、段落、表格、图片、超连结。
  • CSS：描述 HTML 元素的外观，如颜色、字体、版面。
  • JavaScript：嵌入 HTML 的编程语言，加入互动与动态功能，例如按下按钮后有反应。
考试口诀：结构 → HTML，外观 → CSS，互动 → JavaScript。

ex.q: A web page shows a menu that expands when clicked, uses blue Arial headings, and contains a list of products. Which technology handles each feature?
ex.a:
Expanding menu on click → JavaScript (behaviour).
Blue Arial headings → CSS (appearance).
List of products → HTML (structure: <ul>/<li>).
ex.az: 点击展开 = 互动 → JavaScript；蓝色 Arial = 外观 → CSS；产品清单 = 结构 → HTML。

cards.t: HTML is a markup language, not a programming language
cards.tz: HTML 是标示语言，不是编程语言
cards.en: Hypertext Markup Language (HTML) is a standard markup language used to write web pages. It is not a programming language but a cross-platform language used to define the elements used in a web page. HTML has no variables, loops or decisions; it only labels content so the browser knows how to display it. Because it is plain text and a standard, the same HTML file can be opened by browsers on Windows, macOS, Android or iOS (cross-platform). Hypertext means text that contains links to other documents.
cards.zh: HTML（超文本标示语言）是编写网页的标准标示语言。它不是编程语言：没有变量、循环、判断，只是用标记说明内容是什么，让浏览器知道如何显示。HTML 是纯文字和统一标准，所以是跨平台（cross-platform）的，任何作业系统的浏览器都能打开。Hypertext 指含有超连结、可连到其他文件的文字。

ex.q: Is the statement 'HTML is a programming language because it can display a table' correct? Explain.
ex.a: Incorrect. HTML only defines elements (marks up content); it has no programming constructs such as variables, selection or iteration. Displaying a table is just describing structure with <table>, <tr>, <td>.
ex.az: 错误。显示表格只是描述结构，HTML 没有变量、判断、循环，所以不是编程语言。

cards.t: CSS and why it is useful
cards.en: Cascading Style Sheet (CSS) is used to describe the style of HTML elements. Its key advantage: a style can be applied to different pages of the website at the same time without setting them one by one, making the website easier and more efficient to create and maintain. For example, changing one rule h1 {color:navy} in a shared style sheet updates every heading on every page. In this chapter we mostly use CSS through the style attribute (inline style), e.g. <p style="color:blue">.
cards.zh: CSS（层叠样式表）用来描述 HTML 元素的样式。最大好处：同一样式可同时套用到网站多个网页，不用逐页设定，建立和维护网站更容易、更有效率。例如在共用样式表改一条 h1 {color:navy}，所有网页的标题一起改变。本章主要以 style 属性（inline style）使用 CSS，例如 <p style="color:blue">。

ex.q: A school website has 40 pages. The principal wants all headings changed from black to dark green. Why is CSS better than editing each page?
ex.a: With a shared CSS rule (e.g. h1{color:darkgreen}) only one place needs editing; all 40 pages update together, saving time and keeping the style consistent. Editing each page is slow and error-prone.
ex.az: 用共用 CSS 只需改一处，40 页同时更新，省时且风格一致。

cards.en: HTML5 is the fifth version of HTML. To meet the needs of modern websites it added new semantic elements and attributes such as <header>, <footer> and <section>, plus native <audio> and <video>. At the same time, elements that only changed appearance were removed, including <center>, <font> and <frame>; their functions are replaced by CSS. This reflects the principle: HTML for structure, CSS for presentation.
cards.zh: HTML5 是第五版 HTML。为配合现代网站，新增 <header>、<footer>、<section> 等语义元素，并原生支援 <audio>、<video>。同时移除只改外观的 <center>、<font>、<frame>，改由 CSS 负责。原则：HTML 管结构，CSS 管外观。

ex.q: Rewrite the old code <center>Hi</center> in HTML5 style.
ex.a:
<p style="text-align:center">Hi</p>
<center> was removed in HTML5; centring is done with CSS text-align.
ex.az: HTML5 已移除 <center>，改用 CSS 的 text-align:center。

cards.t: How a browser gets a web page (HTTP)
cards.en:
When you open a page:
  1. The client (browser) sends an HTTP request to the web server, e.g. method: GET, path: /index.html.
  2. The server replies with an HTTP response, e.g. status: 200, content-type: text/html, followed by the HTML file.
  3. The browser interprets the HTML (and loads linked CSS, images, scripts) and renders the page.
Status 200 means OK; 404 means the file was not found.
cards.zh:
打开网页时：
  1. 浏览器（client）向 web server 发出 HTTP request，例如 GET /index.html。
  2. Server 回传 HTTP response：status: 200、content-type: text/html 及 HTML 档案。
  3. 浏览器解读 HTML，再载入图片、CSS、脚本，显示网页。
200 = 成功；404 = 找不到档案。

ex.q: A user requests /about.html but the file was deleted. What status will the response contain?
ex.a: 404 Not Found — the server cannot find the requested resource. A successful request would return 200.
ex.az: 档案不存在 → 404 Not Found。

cards.t: HTML editors: text editor vs web authoring tool
cards.tz: HTML 编辑器：文字编辑器 vs 网页制作工具
cards.en:
HTML files can be created with two kinds of tools.
Text editor (e.g. Notepad)Web page authoring tool (e.g. Dreamweaver, Wix)
ProsFound in all operating systems; free; HTML code is concise; full controlWYSIWYG (What You See Is What You Get) – preview shown directly; no need to know HTML; drag-and-drop
ConsMust know HTML; no live previewGenerated code may be long/messy; may cost money
Save the file with extension .html or .htm and open it with a browser. Online editors with real-time preview also exist.
cards.zh: 制作 HTML 档有两类工具：文字编辑器（如 Notepad）——所有作业系统都有、免费、代码精简，但要懂 HTML、不能即时预览；网页制作工具（如 Dreamweaver、Wix）——WYSIWYG（所见即所得），可直接预览、拖放、不必懂代码，但生成的代码可能冗长。档案要以 .html / .htm 储存，再用浏览器开启。

ex.q: Tom saves his page as 'home.txt' and double-clicks it; he sees raw tags. Fix it.
ex.a: Rename/save it as home.html (or .htm). The browser recognises .html files and renders the tags instead of showing them as text.
ex.az: 副档名要改成 .html，浏览器才会解读标记。

cards.tz: 基本 HTML 文件结构
cards.zh: 每个 HTML 网页都有固定骨架：<!DOCTYPE html> 声明 HTML5；<html> 是根元素；<head> 放文件资讯，如 <title>（显示在浏览器分页标签）、<script>，不会显示在网页内容；<body> 包含所有可见内容：标题、段落、表格、图片、超连结。只有 body 的内容会显示在网页上。

ex.q: Where will the text in <title>Shop</title> appear, and where must the <title> tag be placed?
ex.a: It appears on the browser tab / title bar (and bookmarks), not in the page body. <title> must be inside <head>.
ex.az: 标题显示在浏览器分页上；<title> 必须放在 <head> 内。

cards.en:
• A tag is a keyword in angle brackets: start tag <p>, end tag </p>.
  • An element = start tag + content + end tag, e.g. <p>Hi</p>. Some are empty elements with no end tag: <br>, <hr>, <img>.
  • An attribute gives extra information and is written in the start tag as name="value", e.g. <img src="a.png" alt="cat">. Several attributes are separated by spaces.
Elements can be nested but must close in reverse order: <p><b>x</b></p>, not <p><b>x</p></b>.
cards.zh: Tag（标记）：尖括号内的关键字，有开始标记 <p> 与结束标记 </p>。Element（元素）＝开始标记＋内容＋结束标记；<br>、<hr>、<img> 是没有结束标记的空元素。Attribute（属性）写在开始标记内，格式 名称="值"，提供额外资讯。元素可以嵌套，但要按相反次序关闭。

ex.q: In <a href="x.html">Next</a>, identify the tag name, attribute, attribute value and content.
ex.a: Tag name: a; attribute: href; value: x.html; content (link text shown): Next.
ex.az: 标记 a；属性 href；值 x.html；内容 Next。

cards.t: Headings, paragraphs, line breaks and horizontal rules
cards.en:
<h1>The largest title</h1>
<h2>Title 2</h2>   ... <h6>smallest</h6>
<p>Paragraph 1</p>
<p>This is the 1st line<br>This is the 2nd line</p>
<hr>
  • <h1>–<h6>: six levels of headings; h1 is largest/most important.
  • <p>: a paragraph; browsers add space before and after.
  • <br>: line break inside text.
  • <hr>: horizontal rule (line).
Important: the browser ignores extra spaces and line breaks typed in the source code; multiple spaces collapse to one, and pressing Enter in the code does not start a new line. Use <br> or <p>.
cards.zh: <h1>~<h6> 六级标题，h1 最大；<p> 段落，前后自动留空；<br> 换行；<hr> 水平线。重点：浏览器会忽略原始码中多余的空格和换行——多个空格只显示一个，在代码按 Enter 不会换行，要用 <br> 或 <p>。

ex.a:
Line 1: This is the 1st line
Line 2: This is the 2nd line This is also the 2nd line
Only <br> creates a new line; the Enter key in the source becomes a single space.
ex.az: 只有 <br> 换行；代码中的换行只当一个空格，所以后两句在同一行。

cards.en:
<!--This is a comment-->
<pre>This is
    f o r m a t t e d   text</pre>
  • Comments <!-- ... --> are not displayed; they explain code for developers.
  • <pre> displays preformatted text: spaces and line breaks are kept exactly as typed, usually in a fixed-width (monospace) font. Useful for code or ASCII diagrams.
cards.zh: <!-- --> 注释不会显示，用来给开发者说明代码。<pre> 预格式文字会保留原本的空格与换行，通常以等宽字体显示，适合显示程式码。

ex.q: A student wants to show a poem with its exact spacing. Which tag should he use and why?
ex.a: Use <pre>. Normal text collapses spaces and ignores line breaks; <pre> preserves them exactly.
ex.az: 用 <pre>，因为它保留空格和换行。

cards.en:
CodeEffect
<b>bold</b>bold
<i>italic</i>italic
<u>underline</u>underline
<sup>superscript, x2
<sub>subscript, H2O
Tags can be nested, e.g. <b><i>both</i></b>. Avoid underlining normal text because users may think it is a link.
cards.zh: <b> 粗体、<i> 斜体、<u> 底线、<sup> 上标（如 x²）、<sub> 下标（如 H₂O）。标记可嵌套。普通文字少用底线，以免被误会为超连结。

ex.q: Write HTML to show: E = mc² and CO₂ (the 2s raised / lowered correctly).
ex.a:
E = mc<sup>2</sup>
CO<sub>2</sub>
ex.az: 平方用 sup，化学式的 2 用 sub。

cards.t: The style attribute: font, size and alignment
cards.tz: style 属性：字体、大小、对齐
cards.zh: style 属性为单一元素套用 CSS，格式 style="属性:值; 属性:值"。font-family 设定字体；font-size 用 px 或 xx-small ~ xx-large；text-align 设定 left / right / center 对齐。多个属性用分号分隔。

ex.q: Write one paragraph 'Notice' in Arial, 24 px, centred.
ex.a:
<p style="font-family:Arial; font-size:24px; text-align:center">Notice</p>
Three properties in one style attribute, separated by semicolons.
ex.az: 三个属性写在同一个 style 内，用分号分隔。

cards.t: Colours: color, background-color and hex codes
cards.tz: 颜色：color、background-color 与十六进制色码
cards.en:
<h1 style="color:red">This is a red title</h1>
<p style="color:#0000FF">Blue text</p>
<h1 style="background-color:green">Green background</h1>
color sets text colour; background-color sets the background. Colours can be names (red, yellow) or hexadecimal RGB codes #RRGGBB: each pair 00–FF (0–255) is the intensity of Red, Green, Blue.
CodeColour
#FF0000red
#00FF00green (lime)
#0000FFblue
#FFFF00yellow (R+G)
#000000 / #FFFFFFblack / white
Larger values = brighter. #E00000 is a slightly darker red than #FF0000.
cards.zh: color 设文字颜色，background-color 设背景色。颜色可用名称或十六进制 #RRGGBB：每两位（00–FF，即 0–255）分别代表红、绿、蓝的强度。#FF0000 红、#00FF00 绿、#0000FF 蓝、#FFFF00 黄（红＋绿）、#000000 黑、#FFFFFF 白。数值愈大愈亮。

ex.q: What colour is #FF00FF? Which is redder, #FF0101 or #E00000?
ex.a:
#FF00FF = full red + full blue = magenta.
Red component: FF (255) vs E0 (224), so #FF0101 has more red (its tiny G and B values barely change it).
ex.az: #FF00FF 是洋红；比较红色分量 FF＞E0，所以 #FF0101 较红。

cards.en:
<ul>
  <li>Item 1</li>
  <li>Item 2</li>
</ul>
<ol type="a">
  <li>Item 1</li>
  <li>Item 2</li>
</ol>
  • <ul> unordered list – bullets; type="circle" or square changes the bullet.
  • <ol> ordered list – numbered 1, 2, 3; type="a" → a, b, c; type="i" → i, ii, iii; A and I for capitals.
  • Each item uses <li> (list item).
Lists improve readability compared with long paragraphs.
cards.zh: <ul> 无序清单（圆点，可用 type="circle" 等）；<ol> 有序清单（1、2、3；type="a" 变 a、b、c；type="i" 变 i、ii、iii）；每一项用 <li>。清单比长段落更易阅读。

ex.q: Write a list of steps numbered i, ii, iii: Wash, Cut, Cook.
ex.a:
<ol type="i">
  <li>Wash</li>
  <li>Cut</li>
  <li>Cook</li>
</ol>
ex.az: 步骤有次序 → ol，type="i" 显示罗马数字。

cards.en:
<table border="1" style="border-spacing:30">
  <tr style="height:50;vertical-align:top">
    <th>Title 1</th>
    <td>row 1 cell 1</td>
    <td>row 1 cell 2</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <th style="padding:20">Title 2</th>
    <td>row 2 cell 1</td>
    <td>row 2 cell 2</td>
  </tr>
</table>
  • <table> table; <tr> table row; <th> header cell (bold, centred); <td> data cell.
  • border: border thickness (0 = none).
  • border-spacing: space between cells.
  • padding: space between cell content and its border.
  • height, vertical-align (top / middle / bottom) for rows/cells.
Tables are built row by row: count <tr> for rows, cells per <tr> for columns.
cards.zh: <table> 表格、<tr> 一行、<th> 标题格（粗体置中）、<td> 资料格。border 边框粗细；border-spacing 格与格之间的距离；padding 格内文字与边框的距离；height、vertical-align 设高度与垂直对齐。表格按行建立：<tr> 数目 = 行数，每行格数 = 栏数。

ex.q: How many rows and columns does the example table have? What is the difference between padding and border-spacing?
ex.a:
2 rows (two <tr>) and 3 columns (1 th + 2 td per row).
padding = space inside a cell around its content; border-spacing = gap between neighbouring cells.
ex.az: 2 行 3 栏；padding 是格内留白，border-spacing 是格与格之间的距离。

cards.tz: 合并储存格：colspan 与 rowspan
cards.en:
<table border="1">
  <tr><td colspan="2">A (2 columns)</td></tr>
  <tr><td rowspan="2">B (2 rows)</td><td>C</td></tr>
  <tr><td>D</td></tr>
</table>
colspan="n" makes a cell span n columns in the same row; rowspan="n" makes a cell span n rows downward. The positions covered by a merged cell must not get their own <td> in later rows — that is why row 3 has only one td. Check: every row should add up to the same number of columns.
cards.zh: colspan="n" 令一格横跨 n 栏；rowspan="n" 令一格向下跨 n 行。被合并占用的位置，在之后的行中不要再写 <td>，所以第三行只有一格。检查方法：每一行（计入跨行的格）栏数要相同。

ex.q: A 3×3 timetable's first column header 'Mon' should cover rows 2 and 3. Write rows 2–3.
ex.a:
<tr><td rowspan="2">Mon</td><td>ICT</td><td>Maths</td></tr>
<tr><td>PE</td><td>Chem</td></tr>
Row 3 has only 2 <td> because column 1 is occupied by 'Mon'.
ex.az: 第三行第一栏已被 Mon 占用，所以只写两格。

cards.t: Images: img, src, alt, width and height
cards.en:
<p>This is an orange</p>
<img src="orange.png" alt="orange" height="150">
  • src: path of the image file — relative (same folder: orange.png; subfolder: images/orange.png) or absolute URL.
  • alt: alternative text displayed if the image cannot be shown, and read aloud by screen readers (accessibility).
  • width / height: size in pixels; setting only one keeps the aspect ratio.
Common errors: wrong file name/extension or wrong folder → broken image. Audio and video are inserted with <audio> and <video> elements.
cards.zh: src：图片路径，可以是相对路径（同资料夹 orange.png、子资料夹 images/orange.png）或完整网址；alt：图片无法显示时出现的替代文字，也让读屏软件读出；width/height：像素尺寸，只设一项会保持比例。档名、副档名或资料夹错误就会显示破图。影音用 <audio>、<video>。

ex.q: A photo cat.JPG is in the subfolder 'pics'. The code <img src="cat.jpg"> shows a broken image. Give two possible errors and fix the code.
ex.a:
1. The folder is missing: path should be pics/cat.JPG.
2. The file name/extension case may not match on the server (cat.jpg vs cat.JPG).
Fix: 
<img src="pics/cat.JPG" alt="my cat">
ex.az: 缺了资料夹路径；副档名大小写不符。改正并加上 alt。

cards.en:
<p><a href="https://www.google.com">Go to Google</a></p>
<p><a href="HTML File 2.html">Go to another web page</a></p>
Hyperlinks are defined with the anchor tag <a>; href gives the destination — an external URL (absolute), another page/file in the site (relative path), or a location on a page. The content between <a> and </a> is what users click. Hyperlinks support the architecture of the entire website. An image link is made by putting <img> inside <a>: <a href="home.html"><img src="logo.png" alt="Home"></a>. mailto: links open an email client.
cards.zh: 超连结用 anchor tag <a>，href 指定目的地：外部网址、网站内另一页（相对路径）或页内位置。<a> 与 </a> 之间的内容就是可按的文字。超连结支撑整个网站的架构。把 <img> 放进 <a> 就成图片连结。

ex.q: Make the school logo logo.png a link to index.html.
ex.a: <a href="index.html"><img src="logo.png" alt="School logo"></a>
ex.az: 把 img 放入 a 元素内。

cards.tz: 锚点：跳到页面指定位置
cards.zh: 先用 name（或 id）定义锚点，再用 href="#名称" 连过去。连到同一页的锚点，href 的值前必须加 “#”；连到另一页的锚点写成 档名.html#名称。常用于长网页、FAQ、“回到顶部”。

ex.q: Create a 'Back to top' link at the bottom of a long page.
ex.a:
At the top: <a name="top"></a> (or <h1 id="top">).
At the bottom: <a href="#top">Back to top</a>.
ex.az: 顶部设锚点 top，底部用 href="#top"。

cards.en:
<h1>This is the homepage</h1>
<iframe src="A.html" width="500" height="500"></iframe>
<iframe src="B.html" width="500" height="500"></iframe>
Frames embed another HTML file in the current file and create a specific window (frame) to display it. The traditional <frameset>/<frame> were removed in HTML5; today we use <iframe> (inline frame) with src, width and height. Common uses: embedding a map, a video player or another page of the site.
cards.zh: 框架可把另一个 HTML 档嵌入目前网页，并开一个视窗显示它。传统 <frameset>/<frame> 已在 HTML5 移除，现用 <iframe>，配合 src、width、height。常用于嵌入地图、影片或网站其他页面。

ex.q: Embed news.html in a 600×300 window below a heading.
ex.a:
<h2>Latest news</h2>
<iframe src="news.html" width="600" height="300"></iframe>
ex.az: 用 iframe 的 src 指定档案，width/height 设大小。

cards.tz: HTML 电邮与纯文字电邮
cards.en: Emails can be written in HTML format. HTML email allows text formatting (colours, bold, images, hyperlinks, tables), so it looks like a mini web page. Plain-text email has no formatting but is smaller and less likely to hide malicious links. Both can be received with POP3 or IMAP; the email protocol is not affected by the format.
cards.zh: 电邮可用 HTML 格式撰写：可套用文字格式（颜色、粗体、图片、超连结、表格）。纯文字电邮没有格式，但档案较细、较难藏恶意连结。两种都可以用 POP3 或 IMAP 收取。

ex.q: State one advantage of sending a newsletter as an HTML email.
ex.a: Text formatting can be applied: headings, colours, images and clickable links make the newsletter attractive and easy to read.
ex.az: 可以加入格式、图片、连结，更吸引及易读。

cards.tz: 网站结构：线性、层级、矩阵
cards.en:
Website design has two parts: architecture design (structure) and interface design. Before building, plan the structure and content, like an essay outline; most sites have Home, About Us and Contact Us.
  • Linear structure: pages are linked one after another in sequence (Next/Previous). Good for tutorials, step-by-step guides, stories.
  • Hierarchical structure: a tree – the homepage branches into categories and sub-pages. Used by most websites (school, shop).
  • Matrix (web) structure: pages are interlinked so users can jump freely between any pages. Flexible but can confuse users without good navigation.
A well-organised architecture links pages clearly and strengthens the user experience.
cards.zh:
网站设计分为架构设计与介面设计。建站前要先规划结构和内容，就像写文章先拟大纲。
  • 线性结构：页面依次连接（上一页/下一页），适合教学步骤、故事。
  • 层级结构：首页分支成类别和子页，像树状，多数网站使用。
  • 矩阵结构：页面互相连结，可自由跳转，灵活但需要好的导航。

ex.q: Choose a structure for (a) a 10-step online tutorial on installing software, (b) a secondary school website.
ex.a:
(a) Linear – users must follow steps in order.
(b) Hierarchical – Home → About / Academic / Admissions → sub-pages for each subject, etc.
ex.az: 步骤教学用线性；学校网站分类多用层级。

cards.en:
UI (User Interface) refers to the graphic design and appearance of a web page, including pages, buttons, icons and other visual elements users interact with. A UI designer determines the look and feel – colours, fonts, layout.
UX (User Experience) refers to users' impression of the website and their overall experience when browsing it. A UX designer researches user needs. User research should be conducted before designing to satisfy users as much as possible. Sites differ by purpose and target audience: a site for the elderly needs large text and simple navigation; a site for children uses bright colours and pictures.
cards.zh: UI（用户介面）指网页的图像设计与外观：页面、按钮、图示等视觉元素，UI 设计师决定颜色、字体、版面。UX（用户体验）指用户浏览网站时的印象和整体经验，UX 设计师研究用户需要。设计前应先做用户研究。不同对象需求不同：长者要大字体、简单导航；儿童要鲜艳色彩和图画。

ex.q: A banking app looks beautiful but users take 8 taps to transfer money. Is this mainly a UI or UX problem?
ex.a: Mainly a UX problem: the appearance (UI) is fine, but the overall experience/flow is inefficient. Fix by simplifying the transfer process after user research.
ex.az: 外观好但流程差 → UX 问题。

cards.en: Before actually creating a web page, sketching a wireframe helps us plan the content and layout of the page, just like drafting before a painting. A wireframe shows where the header, navigation bar, images, text blocks and footer go, using simple boxes. It does not need to be perfect – keep it simple; colour design can be decided later. Wireframes let the team agree on structure early and avoid costly changes.
cards.zh: 实际制作网页前，先画线框图（wireframe）规划内容和版面，像画画先打草稿。用简单方框标示页首、导航列、图片、文字区、页尾的位置。不必完美，保持简单，颜色之后再决定。

ex.q: List the boxes you would draw in a wireframe for a restaurant homepage.
ex.a: Header with logo; navigation bar (Home, Menu, Booking, Contact); hero photo; short introduction text; opening hours box; booking button; footer with address/map.
ex.az: 页首+logo、导航列、主图、介绍、营业时间、订座按钮、页尾。

cards.t: Website navigation: navigation bar and sitemap
cards.tz: 网站导航：导航列与网站指南
cards.en:
Unclear navigation forces visitors to waste time searching. Good navigation lets visitors find information quickly, improving user experience and keeping them on the site longer.
  • Navigation bar: lets visitors quickly understand how information is arranged (like exit signs in a subway). Tips: lock it at the top of the page; keep the number of options small; button text concise; font clear; buttons neither too small (hard to click) nor too large.
  • Sitemap: like a shopping-mall directory, it lists the sections of the website in detail, helping visitors and search engines locate relevant information quickly.
  • Proper use of hyperlinks also makes a site user-friendly.
cards.zh: 导航不清楚，访客要花很多时间找页面。好的导航令访客快速找到资讯，改善体验，留得更久。导航列：像地铁出口指示；宜固定在页顶、选项不要太多、文字简洁、按钮大小适中。网站指南（sitemap）：像商场指南，详列网站各部分，帮助访客和搜寻器快速找到资料。

ex.q: A shop's navigation bar has 18 buttons in tiny font. Suggest two improvements.
ex.a: Reduce the number of top-level options (group into categories with sub-menus); enlarge the font/buttons so they are clear and easy to click; fix the bar at the top of the page.
ex.az: 减少选项并分类；放大字体和按钮；固定在页顶。

cards.tz: 跨平台与响应式网页设计
cards.en: A cross-platform design means the website can operate on different platforms, such as desktop computers and mobile devices. Most websites now share the same URL for mobile and desktop versions; the site switches automatically. Responsive web design makes the web content adapt to different screen sizes, platforms and device orientations by resizing, hiding or rearranging elements. Benefits: looks good on all devices and saves hours of work creating multiple layouts. Also reduce image file size for mobile users rather than uploading huge photos.
cards.zh: 跨平台设计指网站能在桌面电脑、流动装置等不同平台运作。现今多数网站手机与桌面版共用同一网址，自动切换。响应式设计令内容按萤幕大小、平台和方向自动调整（缩放、隐藏、重新排列）。好处：所有装置都好看，省去制作多个版面的时间。上载相片前也应缩小档案。

ex.q: Janet wants to put large camera photos on her responsive blog. What should she do?
ex.a: Reduce/compress the photos (resize to suitable resolution, use JPG/WebP) before uploading so pages load quickly on mobile data, and let the layout scale images to the screen width.
ex.az: 上载前缩小或压缩相片，让手机快速载入。

cards.en:
Readability refers to the extent to which the content of a web page is easy to read and understand. Suggestions:
  • Use lists and tables instead of paragraphs to express complex information.
  • Include multimedia elements (pictures, audio, video, animation) to attract interest and present ideas more easily.
  • Font size and colour combinations: use different colours, positions, sizes and fonts to emphasise key points; keep high colour contrast between text and background; use a harmonious colour scheme suited to the purpose (professional vs. learning site).
  • Avoid complicated background pictures behind text.
cards.zh: 可读性指网页内容容易阅读和理解的程度。建议：用清单和表格代替长段落；加入多媒体吸引兴趣；用颜色、大小、字体突出重点，文字与背景保持高对比；配色和谐；避免复杂背景图。

ex.q: A page shows yellow text on a white background with a busy photo behind it. Improve readability.
ex.a: Use dark text (e.g. #000000) on a light plain background for high contrast; remove or blur the background photo; break long text into a list or table.
ex.az: 改用深色字、浅色纯背景，移除复杂背景，用清单分点。

cards.en:
Besides free-text boxes, special input elements make data entry easier and more accurate:
  • Drop-down list – choose one value from a list (e.g. district, store branch).
  • Slider – choose a value in a range (price, volume).
  • Date picker – choose a date from a calendar.
  • ▲▼ buttons, radio buttons, checkboxes.
Users can only select from specific values, which ensures the data entered is within expectations and reduces input errors; it is also faster on touch screens. Text boxes are still needed for free information like names, but need validation.
cards.zh: 除文字框外，可用下拉清单、滑杆、日期选择器、▲▼ 按钮等。用户只能从指定值中选择，确保资料在预期范围内，减少输入错误，在触控萤幕上也更快。姓名等自由资料仍需文字框并加以验证。

ex.q: A booking site uses a date picker instead of typing dates. Give two advantages. (Adapted from textbook Checkpoint)
ex.a:
1. It ensures the date exists – e.g. a user cannot enter 31 February.
2. It ensures the range is logical – the start date must be earlier than the end date. (Also faster and avoids format errors such as 03/04 vs 04/03.)
ex.az: 日期必定存在；开始日期早于结束日期；免格式混乱。

cards.en:
Web accessibility design makes the information on a website accessible to everyone, including people with visual impairment, hearing impairment and physical disability. It is a social responsibility and also attracts more users. Examples:
  • Font size options so visitors can resize text while graphics stay the same.
  • Alternative text (alt) for images – screen readers cannot interpret images on their own; alt text lets them read out a description.
  • High colour contrast; captions/subtitles for video (hearing impaired).
  • Multi-language content for ethnic minorities (about 8% of HK population) to reduce language barriers.
  • Keyboard navigation for users who cannot use a mouse.
cards.zh: 无障碍网页设计令所有人都能取得网站资讯，包括视障、听障和肢体伤残人士。这是社会责任，也吸引更多用户。例子：可调字体大小；为图片加 alt 替代文字，让读屏软件读出描述；高对比度；影片字幕；多语言内容照顾少数族裔（约占香港人口 8%）；支援键盘操作。

ex.q: Which features help a blind user browse a government site?
ex.a: Alt text on all images, proper headings and link text that make sense when read aloud by a screen reader, and keyboard-accessible navigation.
ex.az: 图片 alt 文字、清楚标题与连结文字、键盘可操作。

cards.en:
• Loading speed: compress/resize images (e.g. convert BMP to JPG to reduce file size), avoid unnecessary large videos.
  • Consistency: same layout, colours and navigation on every page.
  • Target audience: elderly → large font, large buttons, simple navigation, concise neat structure; children → bright pictures.
  • Up-to-date and correct content; check for broken links before publishing.
  • Copyright: use images and media you have rights to.
  • Contact information and privacy statement.
cards.zh: 载入速度：压缩图片（如 BMP 转 JPG 减少档案大小）；一致性：每页版面、颜色、导航一致；目标用户：长者要大字、大按钮、简单导航；内容准确及更新，发布前检查失效连结；版权；提供联络资料和私隐声明。

ex.q: James converts an image from BMP to JPG. What is the main reason?
ex.a: To reduce the file size so the web page loads faster (JPG uses lossy compression; BMP is uncompressed).
ex.az: 主要为减少档案大小，加快网页载入。

cards.en:
Wix is an easy-to-use drag-and-drop web interface design tool that provides free web hosting, so others can browse your pages over the Internet. Steps:
  1. Go to Wix and click Get Started; log in or register.
  2. Create New Site → choose a template or Blank Template → Edit.
  3. Click Add and embed an HTML code widget; drag to position/resize.
  4. Enter Code → type HTML → Apply to preview.
  5. Menus and Pages → Rename to set the page title; add more pages.
  6. Click Save, then Publish to get the site URL.
cards.zh: Wix 是易用的拖放式网页设计工具，并提供免费网页寄存。步骤：Get Started 登入 → Create New Site 选模板或空白模板 → Add 嵌入 HTML code widget 并拖放调整 → Enter Code 输入 HTML，Apply 预览 → Menus and Pages 改页名 → Save 再 Publish 取得网址。

ex.q: After editing, Amy closes Wix without clicking Publish. Can her friends see the new site?
ex.a: No. Save only stores the draft; she must click Publish to put the site online at its URL.
ex.az: 只储存未发布，朋友看不到，要按 Publish。

cards.en: Web hosting stores website files on a server connected to the Internet. Free hosting providers usually limit storage space and browsing speed; the URL often contains the provider's name and ads may appear. Purchasing a hosting plan allows a large number of users to visit at the same time and increases storage and speed, and you can connect your own domain name (e.g. www.myclub.hk). Choose based on expected traffic, budget, storage needs and need for a custom domain.
cards.zh: 网页寄存把网站档案放在连上互联网的伺服器。免费寄存通常限制储存空间和浏览速度，网址带供应商名称，可能有广告。付费方案可让大量用户同时浏览，增加空间和速度，并可连接自订域名。

ex.q: A school club expects 2000 visitors during its online sale week. Free or paid hosting?
ex.a: Paid hosting: free plans limit speed and simultaneous visitors, so the site may become slow; paid plans give more bandwidth/storage and a custom domain that looks professional.
ex.az: 访客多，选付费寄存以保证速度与容量。

sec: 5.2 Effective Measures to Improve Network Security

cards.en: Malware refers to programs that can damage computer functions, steal user data, gain unauthorised access, or attack networks. The word comes from malicious software. The six common types in the syllabus are virus, worm, Trojan program, spyware, adware and ransomware. They differ in how they spread (needs a host file or not, needs the user to run it or not), whether they self-replicate, and their goal (destroy data, steal information, show ads, extort money, take remote control). In exam answers, always name the type and describe its behaviour precisely rather than just saying 'a virus'. Protection is layered: antivirus software, firewall, software updates, careful handling of emails/downloads and regular backup.
cards.zh: Malware（恶意软件）指可以破坏电脑功能、窃取用户数据、取得未经授权存取或攻击网络的程式。考纲的六种：virus、worm、Trojan program、spyware、adware、ransomware。分辨重点：①传播方式（要不要依附文件、要不要用户执行）②会否自我复制 (self-replicate) ③目的（破坏、偷资料、弹广告、勒索、遥控）。答题时要写出类型及具体行为，不要只写“病毒”。防护要多层：防毒软件、防火墙、更新软件、小心电邮及下载、定期备份。

ex.q: A program shows pop-up ads and secretly records the websites the user visits. Classify it.
ex.a: It shows ads → adware; it secretly collects browsing data → also spyware. Some adware is spyware at the same time.
ex.az: 弹广告是 adware，偷偷记录浏览是 spyware，一个程式可同时属两类。

cards.en: A virus attaches itself to executable files or documents. Once the user executes the program (or opens the document), the virus attacks the files and other data in the computer and replicates itself into other files. Key points to memorise: (1) it needs a host file; (2) it is activated by the user's action of running the host; (3) it self-replicates. Typical effects: corrupted or deleted files, slow system, abnormal behaviour. It spreads when infected files are copied through USB drives, email attachments or downloads. Prevention: scan files before opening, keep antivirus signatures updated, do not run programs from unknown sources.
cards.zh: Virus 会依附 (attach) 在可执行文件或文件上，当用户执行该程式，病毒就会攻击电脑内的文件和数据，并自我复制到其他文件。要背三点：①需要宿主文件 (host file)；②由用户执行宿主时启动；③会自我复制。影响：文件损坏/删除、系统变慢。经 USB、电邮附件、下载的受感染文件传播。预防：开启前扫描、更新病毒码、不执行来历不明程式。

ex.q: Peter copies a game.exe from a friend's USB. After running it, many .exe files on his PC grow in size and crash. What malware is likely, and why?
ex.a: A virus: it was attached to game.exe, activated when Peter executed it, then replicated itself into other executable files (making them larger and corrupt).
ex.az: 依附 exe、执行后才发作、感染其他 exe → virus。

cards.en: A worm is self-replicating malware that does not need to be attached to any file and can spread to other computers on the network by itself. For example, after a user opens a worm-infected email attachment, the worm sends copies of itself to every address in the address book (the ILOVEYOU worm sent up to 300 emails per infected computer). Because the emails come from known contacts, recipients are less alert, so worms spread very fast and consume network bandwidth and system resources. Difference from a virus: no host file needed and spreads automatically through the network. Prevention: do not open unknown attachments, enable spam filtering, patch the OS, use a firewall.
cards.zh: Worm 是会自我复制的恶意软件，不需依附任何文件，能自行经网络传播到其他电脑。例如打开带 worm 的电邮附件后，它会自动寄给通讯录所有人（ILOVEYOU 每部电脑可发 300 封）。由于邮件来自熟人，收件人戒心低，所以传播极快，并耗尽网络频宽和系统资源。与 virus 的分别：毋须宿主文件，自动经网络扩散。预防：不开陌生附件、启用垃圾邮件过滤、更新 OS、用防火墙。

ex.q: Why did the ILOVEYOU worm spread so rapidly?
ex.a: 1. It emailed itself automatically to all contacts in the address book (self-replicating via network). 2. The emails came from known contacts, so recipients trusted and opened them. 3. The attractive subject lured users to open the attachment.
ex.az: 自动寄给全部联络人＋来自熟人＋吸引的标题。

cards.en: A Trojan program disguises itself as a useful application to lure users into installing it. Once inside, it may create a backdoor that allows hackers to invade the computer, gain remote control of the device, steal files and monitor network activities. The name comes from the wooden Trojan horse in Greek legend. Unlike viruses and worms, a Trojan does not self-replicate; it relies on the user being tricked. Signs: software from unofficial sources, cracked software, unexpected network activity. Prevention: download only from official app stores/websites, check publisher and reviews, scan installers with antivirus.
cards.zh: Trojan 伪装成有用的应用程式，引诱用户安装。进入后可能建立后门 (backdoor)，让黑客入侵、遥距控制设备、偷文件、监察网络活动。名称来自希腊神话木马。与 virus、worm 不同，Trojan 不会自我复制，靠欺骗用户。迹象：非官方来源、破解软件、不明网络活动。预防：只在官方网站/商店下载、检查发行者及评价、安装前扫描。

ex.q: Which threats exist on a computer infected by a Trojan? (1) files stolen (2) remote control by hacker (3) it copies itself to all contacts
ex.a: (1) and (2) only. A Trojan can open a backdoor for stealing files and remote control, but it does not self-replicate, so (3) describes a worm.
ex.az: 木马不会自我复制，(3) 是 worm。

cards.en: Spyware's main purpose is to steal the user's personal information such as browsing history, account passwords and even keyboard input (keylogging). Unlike other malware it does not visibly damage the system; it hides to avoid being noticed, and the stolen data is used to steal money or is resold. Adware profits from displaying advertisements in pop-up windows or banners; some adware is also spyware, hiding first then collecting data to target ads. Symptoms of either: many pop-ups, changed home page or search engine, unknown toolbars, slow computer and network. Remove with anti-spyware/antivirus scanning and remove suspicious browser plug-ins.
cards.zh: Spyware 主要目的是窃取个人资料：浏览纪录、帐户密码、甚至键盘输入 (keylogging)。它不明显破坏系统，会隐藏避免被发现，资料用来盗款或转售。Adware 靠显示广告（弹出视窗、横幅）获利，部分同时是 spyware。症状：大量弹窗、首页/搜寻器被改、出现不明工具列、电脑及网络变慢。处理：用防毒/反间谍软件扫描、移除可疑浏览器插件。

ex.q: Mary's banking password was stolen although she never told anyone, and her PC shows no obvious damage. Which malware is most likely?
ex.a: Spyware (e.g. a keylogger): it secretly records keyboard input and sends it to the hacker while hiding from the user, so there is no visible damage.
ex.az: 无明显破坏但密码被偷 → spyware/keylogger。

cards.en: Ransomware is malware that encrypts the files in a computer; the hacker then demands a ransom for decryption. If the victim does not pay in time the ransom may increase or the files are permanently deleted. Example: WannaCry (2017) used the stolen NSA tool 'Eternal Blue' to exploit an unpatched Windows vulnerability and spread like a worm. Both enterprises and home users are targets. What to do if infected: do not pay (no guarantee of decryption and it funds crime), disconnect from the network to stop spreading, report to the police, restore from backup. Prevention: regular offline backup, update OS, firewall, antivirus, avoid suspicious attachments.
cards.zh: Ransomware 会把电脑文件加密，黑客再要求付赎金才解密。逾期赎金加倍或永久删除。例：WannaCry 利用偷来的 Eternal Blue 攻击未更新的 Windows 漏洞，像 worm 般扩散。中招时：不要付款（不保证解密、资助罪案）、断开网络防扩散、报警、由备份还原。预防：定期离线备份、更新系统、防火墙、防毒软件、不开可疑附件。

ex.q: Ken's files become unreadable and a message demands HK$3000 in Bitcoin. Give TWO correct actions and ONE preventive measure.
ex.a: Actions: disconnect the PC from the network; report to the police; restore files from backup (do not pay). Prevention: keep regular offline backups / update OS and antivirus.
ex.az: 断网、报警、用备份还原；预防：定期备份、更新。

cards.en: Malware enters a victim's computer by these means: (1) Dynamic web pages and client-side scripts – malicious scripts run in the browser when visiting a compromised site; (2) Communication software and email – infected attachments and links, often sent automatically to all contacts; (3) Freeware and shareware – free downloads bundled with malware; (4) Various storage devices – USB drives, CDs, memory cards. Knowing the channel lets you suggest the matching prevention: browser updates and disabling unknown scripts; not opening suspicious attachments; downloading from official sources; scanning removable media before use.
cards.zh: 恶意软件入侵途径：①动态网页及客户端脚本 (client-side scripts)：浏览被入侵网站时执行恶意脚本；②通讯软件及电邮：附件、连结，会自动发给所有联络人；③免费及共享软件 (freeware/shareware)：捆绑恶意程式；④各种储存装置：USB、光碟、记忆卡。答题要配对预防方法：更新浏览器、不开可疑附件、官方下载、先扫描外置储存。

ex.q: Suggest one spreading channel and its matching prevention for a school computer room.
ex.a: Channel: students plug in USB drives carrying malware. Prevention: antivirus automatically scans removable storage devices / disable autorun.
ex.az: USB → 自动扫描外置装置。

cards.en: Potential threats after infection: unauthorised access to the system or information by others; information being locked, modified, destroyed or stolen; being demanded a ransom to decrypt or retrieve information; exhausted resources of the computer and network leading to a paralysed system; the device being remotely controlled or executing instructions issued by non-users (e.g. becoming a zombie in a botnet). For organisations this means financial loss, leaked customer data, legal liability and damaged reputation.
cards.zh: 感染后威胁：他人未经授权存取系统或资料；资料被锁住、修改、破坏或偷取；被勒索赎金；电脑及网络资源耗尽令系统瘫痪；设备被遥控或执行非用户发出的指令（如成为 botnet 的 zombie）。对机构：金钱损失、客户资料外泄、法律责任、声誉受损。

ex.q: Match: (a) ransomware (b) worm (c) Trojan with a threat.
ex.a: (a) demanded ransom to decrypt information; (b) exhausted network resources / paralysed system; (c) device remotely controlled through a backdoor.
ex.az: 勒索→赎金；蠕虫→耗尽资源；木马→遥控。

cards.en: A MITM attack is a hacker attack between the normal sender and receiver, intercepting or tampering with the communication between the two parties. The hacker establishes separate connections with both sides, so each believes it is talking directly to the other. The attacker can read data (e.g. copy credit card details sent to a website), tamper with transmitted content, and even redirect hyperlinks to malicious websites. A common method is Wi-Fi eavesdropping / evil twin attack: the hacker sets up a free Wi-Fi without a password (often with a name like a real shop's), and monitors all traffic of victims who connect. Defences: use HTTPS (SSL/TLS) and check certificates, use a VPN on public Wi-Fi, avoid unknown open hotspots.
cards.zh: MITM 是黑客介入正常寄件人和收件人之间，截取 (intercept) 或篡改 (tamper) 双方通讯的攻击。黑客分别与两方连线，双方以为直接通讯。可偷看资料（如信用卡号）、篡改内容、甚至把超连结导向恶意网站。常见手法：evil twin attack——设立无密码免费 Wi-Fi（名称仿真店铺），监察连线者所有数据。防范：用 HTTPS 并检查证书、公共 Wi-Fi 用 VPN、避免陌生开放热点。

ex.q: In a café there are two Wi-Fi networks: 'CafeABC' (password on menu) and 'CafeABC_Free' (no password). Why is the second risky?
ex.a: It may be an evil twin set up by a hacker. Since all traffic passes through the hacker's access point unencrypted, he can intercept or tamper with data (MITM), e.g. capture login details.
ex.az: 可能是黑客的 evil twin，所有流量经他的 AP，可截取篡改。

cards.en: A Denial-of-Service (DoS) attack refers to the attempts of hackers to make the target server unable to provide services to users, usually by flooding it with a huge number of requests so that its bandwidth, CPU or memory is exhausted and normal users cannot connect. In a Distributed DoS (DDoS) attack, the hacker uses numerous hacked computers as zombie computers (a botnet) which are remotely controlled to send requests to the target from many places at the same time; zombie owners usually do not know. DDoS is harder to block because traffic comes from many IP addresses. Defences: firewalls/traffic filtering, extra bandwidth, DDoS protection services, keeping your own PC clean so it does not become a zombie.
cards.zh: DoS 是黑客令目标伺服器无法向用户提供服务的攻击，通常以海量请求耗尽频宽、CPU 或记忆体。DDoS (Distributed DoS)：黑客控制大量被入侵的殭尸电脑 (zombie computers / botnet)，从不同地点同时攻击，主人通常不知情；因来源 IP 众多更难阻挡。防范：防火墙/流量过滤、增加频宽、DDoS 防护服务，并保持自己电脑干净以免成为 zombie。

ex.q: An online ticketing site becomes unreachable at 10:00 when tickets go on sale. Logs show millions of requests from 50,000 IP addresses worldwide. Identify the attack and explain 'zombie computer'.
ex.a: A DDoS attack. Zombie computers are hacked computers remotely controlled by the hacker (without owners' knowledge) to send requests to the target simultaneously.
ex.az: 来自大量 IP → DDoS；zombie＝被黑客遥控的电脑。

cards.en: Antivirus software scans the information in a computer and isolates infected files from other files (quarantine), then repairs or deletes them. When scanning a file, it compares the file with the virus signatures in the virus database to identify whether the file contains malware. A virus signature is like a 'fingerprint' – a unique pattern of code that identifies a known malware. Because new malware appears every day, users should enable the automatic update function so the signature database stays current; software relying only on old signatures cannot detect new malware. Good practice: real-time protection on, regular full system scans, scan downloads and USB drives.
cards.zh: 防毒软件扫描电脑资料，把受感染文件与其他文件隔离 (isolate/quarantine)，再修复或删除。扫描时把文件与病毒数据库中的病毒识别码 (virus signatures) 比对。Virus signature 像“指纹”，是识别已知恶意软件的独特程式码模式。新恶意软件每天出现，所以要启用自动更新；只靠旧识别码无法侦测新病毒。好习惯：开启实时保护、定期全机扫描、扫描下载及 USB。

ex.q: A new virus appears today. Paul's antivirus was last updated 6 months ago. Will it detect the virus? Explain.
ex.a: Probably not. Detection compares files with signatures in the database; the new virus's signature is not in Paul's outdated database. He should enable automatic updates.
ex.az: 病毒码未包含新病毒，应自动更新。

cards.en: A firewall filters incoming and outgoing data packets, blocks malicious packets from entering, prevents unauthorised access, and stops the computer from sending malicious packets to other computers. It checks the IP address, type, port and other network information of each packet against defined rules, then allows or blocks it. When a packet is blocked the user is warned, and users can add rules/exceptions (e.g. allow a game program). Firewalls can also filter content and detect intrusions. Note: a firewall does not remove viruses already on the PC – that is antivirus's job; the two complement each other.
cards.zh: 防火墙过滤进出的数据封包 (data packets)，阻挡恶意封包进入，防止未经授权存取，也阻止电脑向外发送恶意封包。它按预设规则检查封包的 IP address、类型、port 等，决定允许或阻挡；被阻挡时会警告用户，用户可加例外规则。亦可过滤内容、侦测入侵。注意：防火墙不会清除已在电脑内的病毒，那是防毒软件的工作，两者互补。

ex.q: A firewall rule: block all incoming packets to port 23; allow port 443 from any IP. A packet arrives for port 23 from 8.8.8.8. Result?
ex.a: Blocked: it matches the rule 'block incoming to port 23' regardless of source IP. A packet to port 443 would be allowed.
ex.az: 目的 port 23 被封锁。

cards.tz: 软件防火墙与硬件防火墙
cards.en: Software firewall: software installed on the computer (e.g. Windows Defender Firewall). It can only protect a single device (or isolate a single network), is easier to install and has a lower cost, but uses the computer's resources. Hardware firewall: a physical device that writes a firewall program into the chip, placed between the internal network and the Internet, protecting all devices in the network. It is more efficient and more stable than firewall software, but the cost of building it is high and needs expertise to configure. Organisations often use both: hardware at the network edge plus software on each PC.
cards.zh: 软件防火墙：装在电脑上的软件，只能保护单一设备，安装容易、成本低，但占用电脑资源。硬件防火墙：把防火墙程式写入晶片的实体设备，置于内联网与 Internet 之间，保护整个网络；比软件更有效率、更稳定，但建置成本高、需专业设定。机构常两者并用。

ex.q: A school with 400 PCs: recommend firewall type.
ex.a: A hardware firewall at the Internet gateway protects all 400 PCs centrally and is more efficient and stable; software firewalls on each PC can add a second layer.
ex.az: 硬件防火墙集中保护全校，PC 可再加软件防火墙。

cards.en: Access control is a network security measure used to restrict users logging in to the system; only authorised users have the credentials. It has three parts (AAA): Authentication – the process of verifying the identity of a user (who can access the data?), e.g. username and password. Authorisation – the process of granting users the access to data (what data can be accessed?), e.g. read only, read and write, full control. Accounting – monitoring the user's access records in the system to ensure the correct use of data (what data is accessed?), e.g. logs of logins and changes.
cards.zh: 存取控制是限制用户登入系统的网络保安措施。三部分：Authentication 认证——核实用户身份（谁可存取？），如用户名＋密码；Authorisation 授权——给予用户存取数据的权限（可存取什么？），如唯读、读写；Accounting 帐号管理——监察用户存取纪录以确保正确使用数据（存取了什么？），如登入及修改纪录。

ex.q: In the school intranet: (i) students log in with ID and password; (ii) students can only view marks, teachers can edit; (iii) the system records who changed marks. Name each.
ex.a: (i) Authentication (ii) Authorisation (iii) Accounting.
ex.az: 认证、授权、帐号管理。

cards.en: A VPN establishes a 'tunnel' between a user's device and the server of a VPN provider to transmit data. The tunnel is not a physical line but formed by tunnelling technology over the Internet. The user installs a VPN application on the device to encrypt network data packets, which protects data transmitted on the Internet and prevents unauthorised access. Hackers and even the ISP see only encrypted traffic, and websites see the VPN server's IP instead of the user's. Applications: (1) Intranet VPN – link LANs of different branches into a private company intranet; (2) Remote access VPN – staff/students at home access internal resources such as network drives; (3) Access WAN via VPN – protect data on public networks from hackers and ISP.
cards.zh: VPN 在用户设备与 VPN 伺服器之间建立“隧道 (tunnel)”传送数据。隧道不是实体线，而是以 tunnelling technology 在 Internet 上形成。用户安装 VPN 程式加密数据封包，保护传输数据、防止未经授权存取。黑客及 ISP 只见加密流量，网站只见 VPN 伺服器的 IP。应用：①Intranet VPN 连接各分行 LAN 成私有内联网；②Remote access VPN 在家存取公司/学校资源；③经 VPN 存取 WAN，在公共网络防黑客及 ISP。

ex.q: A teacher at home needs the school network drive. How does VPN help and why is it secure?
ex.a: She connects with a remote access VPN client to the school VPN server; a tunnel is created over the Internet and all packets are encrypted, so she can access the drive as if in school while intercepted data cannot be read.
ex.az: Remote access VPN＋加密隧道。

cards.en: Wireless signals can be received by anyone in range, so Wi-Fi must be encrypted. WEP (Wired Equivalent Privacy) is the oldest and is easily cracked. WPA (Wi-Fi Protected Access) uses the Temporal Key Integrity Protocol (TKIP), which encrypts transmission data with a constantly changing key. WPA2 is an advanced version of WPA which conforms to higher security standards and is widely used. Security order: WPA2 > WPA > WEP. WPA/WPA2 have a Personal edition (home: one shared password) and an Enterprise edition (business: each user authenticates with own account via a server). Also use a strong Wi-Fi password and change the router's default admin password.
cards.zh: 无线信号范围内任何人都可接收，所以要加密。WEP 最旧、易破解。WPA 使用 TKIP，以不断改变的密钥加密传输数据。WPA2 是 WPA 进阶版，符合更高保安标准，最普遍。安全度：WPA2 > WPA > WEP。分 Personal（家居，共用密码）与 Enterprise（商业，每人用自己帐户经伺服器认证）。并应用强 Wi-Fi 密码、更改路由器预设管理密码。

ex.q: A company with 200 staff uses WEP with one shared password. Suggest improvements.
ex.a: Upgrade to WPA2 (stronger, TKIP/changing key concept) and use the Enterprise edition so each staff logs in with own account; leavers' accounts can be disabled without changing a shared password.
ex.az: 升级 WPA2-Enterprise，每人独立帐户。

cards.t: Hide SSID and MAC address filtering
cards.tz: 隐藏 SSID 与 MAC 地址过滤
cards.en: SSID (Service Set Identifier) is the user-customised Wi-Fi name. Home routers broadcast it so devices list it automatically. Turning off the SSID broadcast function hides the network name so that it cannot be automatically searched by other devices; users must type the name manually. MAC address filtering: the access point only allows devices with MAC addresses on the whitelist to use the Wi-Fi network, preventing unauthorised devices from connecting even if they know the password. Both are extra layers; they are not substitutes for WPA2 encryption (skilled hackers can still detect hidden SSIDs or spoof MAC addresses), and MAC filtering is inconvenient when new devices are added.
cards.zh: SSID 是自订的 Wi-Fi 名称。关闭 SSID broadcast 可隐藏网络名称，令其他设备无法自动搜寻到，需手动输入。MAC 地址过滤：AP 只容许白名单 (whitelist) 上 MAC 地址的设备使用 Wi-Fi，即使知道密码亦不能连。两者只是额外防线，不能代替 WPA2（高手仍可侦测隐藏 SSID 或伪造 MAC）；新增设备时 MAC 过滤较麻烦。

ex.q: Whitelist: 00:00:00:00:00:AA, 00:00:00:00:00:BB. Devices AA, CC, DD try to connect with the correct password. Which succeed?
ex.a: Only AA. CC and DD are not on the whitelist, so the access point rejects them even with the correct password.
ex.az: 只有 AA 在白名单。

cards.en: Many restaurants, coffee shops and malls provide free public Wi-Fi hotspots. As anyone can connect to these public networks, hackers may intrude into them and monitor the incoming and outgoing information. Data may be unencrypted, and a fake hotspot (evil twin) may be used for MITM attacks. Safe practice: connect for general web browsing only; avoid online banking, shopping or entering passwords; use HTTPS sites and a VPN; turn off auto-connect and file sharing; 'forget' the network afterwards; use mobile data for sensitive tasks.
cards.zh: 商场、餐厅提供免费公共 Wi-Fi。任何人都能连接，黑客可入侵并监察进出资料。数据可能未加密，也可能是 evil twin 作 MITM。安全做法：只作一般浏览；避免网银、购物、输入密码；用 HTTPS 及 VPN；关闭自动连接及文件共享；用后“忘记网络”；敏感事情用流动数据。

ex.q: Why is public Wi-Fi dangerous even when the free session is long and fast?
ex.a: Because the data passing through the connection may not be encrypted and anyone (including hackers) can join and intercept it.
ex.az: 风险在于数据未加密、任何人可接入。

cards.en: Users should adopt these settings: disable the 'Pop-ups and redirects' feature (blocks unwanted ads and redirection to malicious sites); enable the automatic update function of the web browser to ensure software vulnerabilities are duly removed; manage plug-ins – install only trusted ones and remove suspicious ones (a browser that keeps showing ads may contain a malicious plug-in/adware); block third-party cookies and enable safe browsing warnings. Regularly update all software and the operating system, because attackers exploit known unpatched vulnerabilities.
cards.zh: 应采用：停用“弹出式视窗及重新导向”；启用浏览器自动更新以修补漏洞；管理插件 (plug-ins)，只装可信任的、移除可疑的（不断弹广告可能是恶意插件/adware）；封锁第三方 cookies、启用安全浏览警告。并定期更新所有软件及 OS，因攻击者利用已知未修补漏洞。

ex.q: Jane's browser keeps opening ad pages after she installed a 'free video downloader' extension. Suggest two actions.
ex.a: Remove/disable the suspicious plug-in; disable pop-ups and redirects; scan with antivirus; update the browser.
ex.az: 移除插件、停用弹窗、扫描。

cards.en: Eavesdropping refers to the unauthorised interception and monitoring of the content of other people's private communications without consent. It is possible to eavesdrop on phone calls, instant messages, emails, video calls and network traffic (e.g. on unencrypted Wi-Fi). It is difficult to detect whether the data has been intercepted, because the victim's network appears to work normally. The main defence is encryption (HTTPS, end-to-end encrypted messaging, WPA2, VPN), since intercepted encrypted data cannot be read.
cards.zh: 窃听指未经同意，截取及监察他人私人通讯内容。对象包括电话、即时讯息、电邮、视像通话及网络流量（如未加密 Wi-Fi）。很难察觉资料是否被截取，因网络看来一切正常。主要防范是加密（HTTPS、端对端加密、WPA2、VPN），被截取的加密数据也读不到。

ex.q: Why is encryption the best defence against eavesdropping rather than detection?
ex.a: Eavesdropping is hard to detect because the network works normally; encryption ensures that even if data is intercepted, the content cannot be understood.
ex.az: 难以察觉，所以用加密令截取无用。

cards.en: Hacking refers to hackers' behaviour of using different methods to attack and destroy network security and gain unauthorised access to information in a computer or system. Consequences: data and files stored in the computer may be stolen or destroyed; the content of a website may be changed and vandalised; the computer may become a zombie computer and launch a denial-of-service attack on websites. For enterprises (e.g. an airline whose passenger data was hacked) losses include leaked personal data, compensation, legal liability, loss of customers and reputation; for citizens, identity theft and financial loss. In Hong Kong hacking is a crime under the Telecommunications Ordinance s.27A and Crimes Ordinance s.161.
cards.zh: 黑客入侵指黑客用各种方法攻击和破坏网络保安，未经授权取得电脑或系统资料。后果：资料文件被偷或破坏；网站内容被篡改破坏；电脑变成 zombie 去发动 DoS 攻击。企业（如航空公司乘客资料被盗）损失：资料外泄、赔偿、法律责任、失去客户与声誉；市民：身份盗用、金钱损失。在香港属刑事罪行（电讯条例 27A、刑事罪行条例 161）。

ex.q: An airline's customer database is hacked. State one loss to the airline and one to customers.
ex.a: Airline: loss of reputation and customers / compensation / legal liability. Customers: personal data leaked → identity theft or fraud.
ex.az: 航空：声誉、赔偿；客户：身份盗用。

cards.en: Social engineering generally refers to a scammer's behaviour of manipulating the trust between people or the victim's greed to trick the victims into disclosing confidential personal information, such as credit card information and passwords. It attacks people rather than technology, so firewalls and antivirus cannot fully stop it. It is also a common method of spreading malware. Common attacks: baiting, quid pro quo, catfishing, pretexting and phishing. General defences: be suspicious of unexpected requests, verify identity through an independent channel, never disclose passwords/verification codes, think before clicking. Hotline in HK: Anti-Deception Coordination Centre 18222.
cards.zh: 社交工程指骗徒操控人与人之间的信任或受害人的贪念，诱骗受害人透露机密个人资料（信用卡、密码）。攻击的是人而非技术，防火墙防毒软件不能完全阻止。亦是散播恶意软件的常见方法。类型：baiting、quid pro quo、catfishing、pretexting、phishing。防范：对意外要求保持怀疑、用独立途径核实身份、绝不透露密码/验证码。香港防骗热线 18222。

ex.q: Why can't antivirus software fully protect against social engineering?
ex.a: Social engineering tricks the person into voluntarily giving information (e.g. telling a password on the phone); no malicious code may be involved for the software to detect.
ex.az: 骗的是人，未必涉及恶意程式。

cards.en: Baiting: scammers exploit the victim's curiosity. For example, they leave CDs or USB drives containing malware in public places; if someone picks one up and inserts it into a computer, the malware installs automatically. Quid pro quo ('something for something'): scammers claim to provide services or goods and ask the victim to disclose personal information in exchange, e.g. 'free gift / free tech support – just give us your email account and password'. Difference: baiting relies on curiosity with a physical/digital bait; quid pro quo offers a benefit in exchange for information. Defence: never plug in unknown USB drives; no legitimate service asks for your password.
cards.zh: Baiting 诱饵：利用好奇心，在公众地方留下载有恶意软件的 USB/光碟，有人插入电脑就自动安装。Quid pro quo 交换条件：声称提供服务或货品，要求受害人交出个人资料作交换，如“免费礼物/技术支援，只需提供电邮帐户和密码”。分别：baiting 靠好奇心与诱饵；quid pro quo 以利益换资料。防范：不插来历不明 USB；正当服务不会索取密码。

ex.q: A caller says 'I'm from IT support; I'll upgrade your PC for free if you give me your login password.' Which attack?
ex.a: Quid pro quo: a service is offered in exchange for confidential information.
ex.az: 以服务换密码 → quid pro quo。

cards.en: Catfishing: scammers use others' photos and personal information to create fake social media accounts, build online relationships (often romance) and then fabricate pitiful stories to ask for money. A HK woman remitted HK$180 million over four years to a 'British engineer' she never met. Signs: refuses video calls or meetings, strange excuses, repeated requests for money. Pretexting: scammers pretend to be someone else to gain trust (a friend, a bank officer, a 'secret agent'), e.g. a 'friend' on WhatsApp asks you to send the verification code, then hijacks your account and asks your contacts to buy gift cards. Defence: verify identity by calling the person directly; never share verification codes.
cards.zh: Catfishing：骗徒盗用他人相片和资料建立假社交帐户，发展网恋后编造可怜故事要钱（有港女四年汇款 1.8 亿给从未见面的“英国工程师”）。迹象：拒绝视像或见面、借口古怪、不断要钱。Pretexting 假托：冒充他人取得信任（朋友、银行职员、“特工”），如 WhatsApp“朋友”要你转发验证码，再盗用帐户叫你的联络人买礼品卡。防范：直接致电本人核实，绝不分享验证码。

ex.q: Suggest TWO ways to identify catfishing.
ex.a: The person refuses video calls or meeting in person; reverse image search shows the profile photo belongs to someone else; repeated requests for money with strange excuses.
ex.az: 拒绝视像、相片反向搜寻、不断要钱。

cards.en: Phishing refers to scammers' behaviour of forging official websites and sending messages (emails/SMS) to deceive victims into visiting fake websites and entering personal information such as login names, passwords and credit card numbers. Phishing websites are websites forged by scammers to look like real ones (e.g. fake Hongkong Post page asking to pay a parcel fee). There are also QR code phishing scams. How to identify: sender address or URL slightly misspelt / not the official domain; urgent or threatening tone; asks for passwords or card details; generic greeting; links whose real address differs from displayed text. Defence: do not click links in suspicious messages, type the official URL yourself, check HTTPS and certificate, report to the organisation.
cards.zh: Phishing 指骗徒伪造官方网站，并以电邮/短讯诱骗受害人进入假网站输入个人资料（帐户、密码、信用卡）。Phishing websites 是仿真网站（如假香港邮政要求缴付包裹费）。亦有 QR code phishing。识别：寄件地址/网址拼错或非官方域名；语气紧急或威吓；索取密码或信用卡；称呼笼统；连结实际网址与显示文字不同。防范：不按可疑连结、自行输入官方网址、检查 HTTPS 及证书、向机构举报。

ex.q: An email from 'service@hongk0ngpost-pay.com' says your parcel is held; pay HK$12 at the link within 24 hours. Give three phishing signs.
ex.a: 1. Domain is not the official hongkongpost.hk and uses '0' for 'o'. 2. Urgent time limit. 3. Asks for payment/card details through an emailed link.
ex.az: 假域名、限时催促、经连结索取付款资料。

cards.en: Spamming of electronic messages refers to the behaviour of sending a large number of redundant messages through SMS or emails without the recipient's consent. Spam wastes time, storage and bandwidth, and can also be fraudulent (phishing links, malware attachments). In Hong Kong, commercial electronic messages are regulated by the Unsolicited Electronic Messages Ordinance (Cap. 593): recipients can choose to refuse them (unsubscribe), and senders must honour the request. Example from the book: a tutoring intermediary was investigated for sending unsolicited messages. Defence: spam filter, do not reply or click, unsubscribe from legitimate senders, report.
cards.zh: 滥发电子讯息指未经收件人同意，经 SMS 或电邮大量发送多余讯息。浪费时间、储存与频宽，亦可能带诈骗（钓鱼连结、恶意附件）。香港以《非应邀电子讯息条例》(Cap. 593) 规管商业电子讯息：收件人可选择拒收，发送者必须遵从。防范：垃圾邮件过滤、不回复不按连结、退订、举报。

ex.q: A shop keeps sending promotional SMS after Lily replied 'unsubscribe'. Which law may be violated?
ex.a: The Unsolicited Electronic Messages Ordinance (Cap. 593), because she has indicated refusal to receive commercial electronic messages.
ex.az: 违反 Cap. 593。

cards.en: Many people display personal information on public platforms to make new friends and communicate with different users. Disclosure of too much personal information on the Internet, such as phone numbers and addresses, may lead to identity theft. Personal information is information that can identify a person: name, date of birth, phone number, address, photo, ID number, school. The more easily it identifies you, the more sensitive it is. Consequences: identity theft, cyber bullying, doxing, stalking, economic loss and mental stress. Even small details (school uniform, location tags, birthday posts) can be combined to identify someone. Set accounts to private and share minimally.
cards.zh: 不少人在公开平台展示个人资料以结识朋友；在网上披露过多个人资料（电话、地址）可能导致身份盗用 (identity theft)。个人资料指可识别个人的资料：姓名、出生日期、电话、地址、相片、身份证号码、学校等，愈易识别愈敏感。后果：身份盗用、网络欺凌、起底 (doxing)、跟踪、经济损失及精神压力。零碎资料（校服、定位、生日帖）组合起来也能认出你。帐户设为私人，尽量少分享。

ex.q: Tom posts his full name, birthday, school and a photo of his HKID card. Explain the risk.
ex.a: Combined, these allow criminals to impersonate him (identity theft), e.g. open accounts or reset passwords using birthday/ID number; he may also be located and harassed.
ex.az: 资料可被组合作身份盗用、起底。

cards.en: Many online system registrations require users to provide personal information that has nothing to do with the nature of the service. For example a free game app asking for HKID number and home address. Personal information may be accessed or transferred to a third party for commercial purposes, or even leaked. Under the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance, data users should only collect data that is necessary and not excessive for the purpose. Users should check whether each field is compulsory, read the privacy policy, and refuse to give unnecessary data.
cards.zh: 很多网上登记要求提供与服务性质无关的个人资料，例如免费游戏要求身份证号码及地址。资料可能被转给第三方作商业用途，甚至外泄。根据私隐条例，资料使用者只应收集必需而不过度的资料。用户应检查哪些是必填、阅读私隐政策、拒绝提供不必要资料。

ex.q: A cinema app requires HKID number, monthly income and home address to buy a ticket. Comment.
ex.a: This is data over-collection: these items are unrelated to buying a ticket; the data could be sold or leaked. Only necessary data (e.g. phone/email for e-ticket) should be collected.
ex.az: 与购票无关 → 过度收集。

cards.en: To protect privacy on the Internet, we should maintain an anonymous identity to prevent activity records from being tracked or leaving traces. Four methods in the book: (1) clear browsing history and cookies; (2) turn off the autofill function; (3) use private browsing; (4) use a proxy server (or VPN) to hide the IP address. Remember that even without entering personal data, the sender's and recipient's IP addresses are visible in data packets, so the ISP, visited websites or a network administrator can still record your activities through your IP address; only a proxy/VPN hides it.
cards.zh: 为保护网上私隐，应保持匿名身份，避免活动被追踪或留下痕迹。书中四法：①清除浏览纪录及 cookies；②关闭自动填写 (autofill)；③使用私密浏览；④使用代理伺服器 (proxy server)（或 VPN）隐藏 IP。注意：即使不输入个人资料，数据封包内仍有寄件及收件 IP，ISP、网站或网管仍可凭 IP 记录活动；只有 proxy/VPN 能隐藏 IP。

ex.q: After using a library computer to check email, what should Amy do to protect privacy?
ex.a: Log out; clear browsing history, cookies and temporary files; ensure autofill did not save her password — or better, use a private browsing window from the start.
ex.az: 登出、清除纪录与 cookies、关闭 autofill／用私密浏览。

cards.en: When a user browses a website, the website generates a cookie to store information on the device to record the user's operations. Cookies record user preferences and browsing behaviour (e.g. items in a shopping cart), the login authentication result so the user stays logged in, and settings such as preferred language and viewed products. They improve user experience but may infringe online privacy. First-party cookies are generated by the website being browsed; third-party cookies are generated by other websites and mainly track user activity across websites to personalise ads (search a product, then see its ad on social media). Many browsers are gradually blocking third-party cookies. Browsers can block websites from using cookies. After using a public computer, clear cookies.
cards.zh: 浏览网站时，网站会产生 cookie 储存在设备上，记录用户的操作。可记录偏好与浏览行为（购物车）、登入认证结果（保持登入）、语言设定、看过的产品。改善体验，但可能侵犯私隐。First-party cookies 由正在浏览的网站产生；third-party cookies 由其他网站产生，主要跨网站追踪用户以投放个人化广告。浏览器正逐步封锁第三方 cookies，亦可设定封锁 cookies。用公共电脑后要清除。

ex.q: Why does Ben see ads for running shoes on social media after searching shoes on an online shop?
ex.a: Third-party cookies (from an ad network embedded in both sites) tracked his activity across websites and used it to personalise ads.
ex.az: 第三方 cookies 跨网站追踪。

cards.en: Autofill: many browsers automatically store account names, passwords, payment methods and addresses entered on web pages and complete them next time. It is convenient on a personal device but very dangerous on a public computer because the next user can retrieve the data – turn it off or use private browsing. Private browsing (Incognito window) is a privacy feature that does not leave browsing history, cookies and input data on the device; when all private windows are closed, their cookies are deleted. Limitations: it does not hide your IP address, so the ISP, websites and network administrators can still see your activity; downloaded files and bookmarks remain. Fun fact from the book: booking sites can't use cookies to raise prices of products you viewed often.
cards.zh: Autofill：浏览器自动储存帐户、密码、付款方式、地址，下次自动填入。私人设备方便，但在公共电脑非常危险，下一位用户可取得资料——应关闭或用私密浏览。私密浏览 (Incognito)：不会在设备留下浏览纪录、cookies 及输入资料；关闭所有私密视窗后 cookies 即被删除。限制：不隐藏 IP，ISP、网站及网管仍见到活动；下载的文件及书签会保留。

ex.q: Is Sam anonymous to his school network admin when using Incognito mode? Explain.
ex.a: No. Incognito only stops data being stored on the device; packets still carry his device's IP address, so the admin can log his activity. A proxy/VPN would be needed to hide the IP.
ex.az: 私密浏览不隐藏 IP。

cards.en: A proxy server plays a similar role to a VPN: it establishes an intermediate connection point between the user and the website, hiding the user's IP address for better privacy. Data packets pass through the proxy before reaching the destination, so the visited website can only record the IP address of the proxy server, not the user's. However, unlike a VPN, the connection to the proxy server is not encrypted. Other functions: because all packets pass through it, a proxy can filter web pages and block specific websites (schools/companies); it has a buffer (cache) storing browsed pages, so loading the same page again is faster.
cards.zh: Proxy server 与 VPN 作用相似：在用户与网站之间建立中介连接点，隐藏用户 IP 以保护私隐。封包先经 proxy 才到目的地，网站只能记录 proxy 的 IP。但与 VPN 不同，连到 proxy 的连线没有加密。其他功能：可过滤网页、封锁指定网站（学校、公司）；有缓冲 (cache) 暂存浏览过的网页，再次浏览更快。

ex.q: Compare proxy server and VPN in two aspects.
ex.a: Both hide the user's IP from websites. Encryption: VPN encrypts packets through a tunnel; proxy connection is not encrypted. Extra: proxy can cache pages to speed up loading and filter websites.
ex.az: 都隐藏 IP；VPN 加密，proxy 不加密但可快取及过滤。

cards.en: Password is a common method to verify user identity; a strong password prevents hackers from easily cracking it. Book's rules: use at least 8 characters; use a mixed combination containing at least 1 number, 1 uppercase letter, 1 lowercase letter and 1 special character; do not use personal information such as date of birth or phone number; do not use passwords that are too simple like '123456'; do not use common words such as 'password'. Longer and more varied passwords increase the number of combinations a brute-force attack must try (e.g. 8 chars from 94 printable symbols = 948 ≈ 6.1×1015).
cards.zh: 密码是常见身份认证方法；强密码令黑客难以破解。规则：至少 8 个字元；混合至少 1 个数字、1 个大写、1 个小写、1 个特殊符号；不用个人资料（生日、电话）；不用太简单的（123456）；不用常见字（password）。愈长、种类愈多，暴力破解要试的组合愈多（8 位、94 种字元 = 948 ≈ 6.1×1015）。

ex.q: Check each: (a) Sam20091026 (b) password1! (c) G7#kq!2Lm
ex.a: (a) Weak – contains birthday (personal info) and no special character. (b) Weak – common word 'password', no uppercase. (c) Strong – 9 chars, upper, lower, digit, special, no personal info.
ex.az: (a) 有生日、无符号；(b) 常见字；(c) 合格。

cards.en: Good habits: change passwords regularly – at least once every three months; do not reuse the last 3 passwords; do not use the same password on different systems (if one site leaks, attackers try it everywhere – 'credential stuffing'); do not record passwords on paper or electronic devices; do not send others your passwords and do not share passwords with others. A password manager or 2FA further improves security.
cards.zh: 好习惯：定期更改，至少每三个月一次；不重用最近 3 个密码；不同系统不用同一密码（一个网站外泄，黑客会拿去试其他网站）；不把密码写在纸上或电子设备；不发送、不分享密码。可配合密码管理器或双重认证。

ex.q: Why is using one password for email, games and banking dangerous?
ex.a: If the game site is hacked and the password leaks, attackers can use the same password to log in to her email and bank accounts.
ex.az: 一处外泄，处处被入侵。

cards.en: Emails are a main channel for malware and phishing. Do not open attachments or hyperlinks in suspicious emails. For attachments, especially those with extensions such as .exe, .vbs and .bat (executable/script files), scan them with antivirus software before opening. Enable spam filtering; do not reply to spam (it confirms your address is active); check the sender's real address. Book example: Ann gets an anonymous email with 'you.exe' claiming to contain her photos; when executed nothing appears – because it is an executable program (likely malware), not a photo.
cards.zh: 电邮是恶意软件和钓鱼的主要途径。不要打开可疑电邮的附件或连结。附件特别是 .exe、.vbs、.bat 等可执行/脚本文件，开启前先用防毒软件扫描。启用垃圾邮件过滤；不回复 spam（会证实地址有效）；检查真实寄件地址。例：Ann 收到匿名附件 you.exe 说是她的相片，执行后没有相片——因为它是程式（可能是恶意软件）而非图片。

ex.q: Which attachments should be scanned first: report.pdf, run.bat, photo.jpg, setup.exe?
ex.a: All should ideally be scanned, but especially run.bat and setup.exe, because .bat and .exe files are executable and can run malicious code directly.

cards.t: HK laws: Telecommunications Ordinance & Crimes Ordinance
cards.tz: 香港法例：电讯条例与刑事罪行条例
cards.en: Cap. 106 Telecommunications Ordinance, Section 27A – Unauthorised access to computer by telecommunications: any person who, by telecommunications, knowingly causes a computer to perform any function to obtain unauthorised access to any program or data held in a computer commits an offence (fine). Cap. 200 Crimes Ordinance, Section 60 – Destroying or damaging property: 'property' includes programs and data in a computer or storage medium; misuse of a computer, or altering, adding or erasing programs/data, counts as damage. Cap. 200 Section 161 – Access to computers with criminal or dishonest intent: dishonest intent includes intent to deceive, to gain for oneself or another, or to cause loss to another; maximum imprisonment 5 years.
cards.zh: Cap. 106《电讯条例》第 27A 条——藉电讯而未获授权取用电脑：明知而经电讯令电脑执行功能以取得未授权存取程式或数据，属罪行（罚款）。Cap. 200《刑事罪行条例》第 60 条——摧毁或损坏财产：财产包括电脑及储存媒体内的程式与数据；误用电脑、更改/加入/删除程式数据均属损坏。第 161 条——有犯罪或不诚实意图而取用电脑：不诚实意图包括欺骗、为自己或他人获利、令他人损失；最高监禁 5 年。

cards.tz: 香港法例：私隐条例与非应邀电子讯息条例
cards.en: Cap. 486 Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance lists six data protection principles regulating how data users collect, process and use personal data: collect by lawful and fair means and minimise collection; before collecting, inform the data subject whether the data is compulsory, the purpose, the classes of persons it may be transferred to, and the right to access and correct; process securely; retain no longer than necessary; do not use for purposes other than the original purpose; data subjects can access/correct their data. Using data for direct marketing or providing it to a third party requires prior notice and consent; penalty up to HK$500,000 and 3 years (HK$1,000,000 and 5 years if provided for gain). Disclosing data obtained without consent to gain or cause harm (doxing) is also an offence. Cap. 593 Unsolicited Electronic Messages Ordinance (effective 22 Dec 2007): people may refuse commercial electronic messages (fax, email, SMS, pre-recorded calls); it does not cover person-to-person real-time calls; offenders may be fined or jailed and victims may claim compensation.
cards.zh: Cap. 486《个人资料（私隐）条例》有六项保障资料原则：合法公平地收集、尽量少收集；收集前告知是否必须提供、目的、可能转交的对象、查阅及改正权；安全处理；保留不超过所需；不得用于原本目的以外；资料当事人可查阅改正。用于直接促销或提供给第三方须事先通知并取得同意，违者最高罚 50 万及监禁 3 年（为得益提供：100 万及 5 年）。未经同意披露资料以图利或造成伤害（起底）亦属违法。Cap. 593《非应邀电子讯息条例》（2007 年 12 月 22 日生效）：可拒收商业电子讯息（传真、电邮、短讯、预录电话），不涵盖人对人实时通话；违者可被罚款或监禁，受害人可索偿。
